description: Music, sound effects and audio processing on /v1/audio/generations: suno-v5 (songs with vocals or instrumental, from a description or your own lyrics), eleven-sfx-v3 and kling-sound-effects (sound effects from text), kling-video-to-audio (soundtrack for a video), eleven-dialogue (multi-speaker dialogue), eleven-dubbing (translate the speech in an audio / video file), eleven-isolator (strip background noise and music, keep the voice). For plain text-to-speech use text_to_speech. Returns the audio URL(s), valid 30 days; long jobs (music, dubbing) hand back a task id for get_task.

audio_url.description: eleven-isolator: the audio to clean. Public URL, LOCAL FILE PATH, localhost URL or data: URI (local files up to 10 MB are uploaded for you).

extra.description: Optional model-specific parameters passed through as-is, e.g. {"continue_clip_id": "…", "continue_at": 30} to extend a Suno song, {"num_speakers": 2} for dubbing, {"prompt_influence": 0.5} for sound effects. See apimodels.app/docs.

inputs.description: eleven-dialogue: the lines in order, each { text, voice_id } (voices from list_voices provider "elevenlabs").

lyrics.description: suno-v5: your own lyrics (use write_lyrics to draft them). Leave out for lyrics written by the model.

model.description: suno-v5, eleven-sfx-v3, kling-sound-effects, kling-video-to-audio, eleven-dialogue, eleven-dubbing or eleven-isolator. Call list_models for the full audio list.

prompt.description: suno-v5: what the song should be about and sound like (the model writes the lyrics); with your own lyrics it is used as the style when tags is empty. Sound effects: describe the sound, e.g. "glass shattering on a tile floor".

source_lang.description: eleven-dubbing: source language code (optional, detected if omitted).

source_url.description: eleven-dubbing: the audio or video whose speech to translate. Same accepted forms.

tags.description: suno-v5: style tags, e.g. "lo-fi hip hop, mellow, female vocals".

target_lang.description: eleven-dubbing: target language code, e.g. es, ja, zh.

video_url.description: kling-video-to-audio: the video to add sound to. Same accepted forms; local videos up to 100 MB.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the audio before returning a task id instead (seconds, 0–900). Default 50: Codex aborts tool calls at 60 s unless tool_timeout_sec is raised. In Claude Code / Claude Desktop you can pass up to 900 to get the URL in one call.

name: generate_audio
